MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

4. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

5. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

9. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

12. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre - Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

7. A — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

10. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre - Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
